notes.title: ❀ Purgatory's Flower is OUT NOW! ❀
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557092/897a880b9d7d100bb262334ef7a313256e951a2c.png"]
❀ Purgatory's Flower is out now! 
Hand-drawn 2D point and click Horror x Dating sim Meet the 'Flowers' imprisoned in hell. 

They long for an escape to purgatory. Your job here is simple. 

Listen to their stories, and break out together. 

Easy, right? ...But, doesn't it seem strange? 
These people... seem to be out of their mind, a bit.


Watch the trailer and do your wishlist!

notes.title: purgatory's flower Demo is on the June Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Demo of purgatory's flower is out ! and we are participating in the June Steam Next Fest 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557092/8974f9513ccb118a6b09994f3323b64bec334cd2.png"]
If you have time, please listen to the characters' stories for a moment.Purgatory flowers will be released in September.
This game deals with the miserable, tragic, and beautiful memories of two women, and the pain and healing that have occurred from them. 


[previewyoutube="_Yws7WmKNG0;full"][/previewyoutube]
The amount of the demo is 1/5 of the total, and the playtime is about 30 minutes. 

several endings are waiting for you.



Demo game only supports English and Korean, but in the main game, English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Ukrainian, and Turkish are waiting. Also, translation volunteering is always welcome!



Please enjoy the stories of prisoners struggling to escape from purgatory!

notes.title: Bug Patch Update Note (2023/11/02)
notes.content:
I'm sorry that there are a lot of bugs because the game has just been released. 
Since the current release date (2023/10/31), there have been many bugs, which have led to several updates a day. Thank you to the users who still played the game. There will be small updates whenever small bugs are reported in the future. 

Today, I solved a bug where I can't see the inventory when I start playing the game again after seeing the ending of the  game that many people have reported. 

If you don't see any game updates, I recommend logging out of Steam and logging back in.
Bug reporting is always welcome.

Thank you!
